display_name: F＋跨 RX 同 TX：全通相位响应纯合成 G0
description: 验证有界非线性相位响应、数值延迟补偿和有限记录边界；不评价身份准确率。
authorization: 当前活跃联合增强 goal：F＋跨 RX 同 TX；每模型 E20。本阶段零训练，仅合成 DSP。

code.environment: Windows native; ssr-gpu Python 3.10; NumPy only; no GPU/Torch/model

data.representation: float32 Bx2x256; true context only as independent synthetic reference
data.validation_ref: 32 cases x 3 fixed alpha; 8 families; no dropped cases

permissions.claim_scope: Engineering correct/incorrect only; no A_g or identity gain claim

checkpoint.selection_rule: all fixed 96 synthetic observations; no selection

execution.stop_rule: First technical exception terminates and preserves artifacts; no automatic retry. Any fixed engineering criterion failure closes this construction; PASS does not launch source or training.

metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent DSP references only; no truth/classification

rows.method: H_a(z)=(a+z^-1)/(1+a*z^-1), a=-.04/0/.04; align numerical one-sample delay; reflection context32; no post normalization
rows.seed_notes: Only data seed constructs synthetic records; all other seeds inapplicable: no model, random augmentation, split, support or stochastic evaluation.
rows.budget_ref: 0 real IQ,0 CP,0 NN,0 updates; no training

notes: F baseline is fixed 3xSIG_TIME + unified Sinc CENTER_UNITS + RDrop + crossRX sameTX SupCon + default cosine30 joint160. No model is invoked here.
E20/model remains upper authorized training budget; this run consumes zero.
G0 consumes no data/CP/NN/remote machinery. Real-checkpoint smoke, N607 preflight/archive/compile and truth-last are not applicable to this stage.
Null optimizer/lr/physical/RX/day/TX/L/U/V/capsule/split/support/query/LEO fields are inapplicable because data are purely synthetic.
No empirical full G0 outcome has been observed before fixing the matrix and limits.
Any per-case boundary-dominated counterexample is retained even if pooled criterion passes.
